    from tvm import tir, runtime
    from tvm.runtime import nd
    from tvm.script import tir as T

    # Fixed dimensions (match the reference model)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    B = T.int64(32)   # batch size
    H = T.int64(32)   # heads
    S = T.int64(512)  # sequence length
    D = T.int64(1024) # embedding dim per head

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Tiling parameters (tuned for the target GPU)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 128 × 128 tiles for the Q‑K matmul, 32 × 32 threads per block
    TILE_M = T.int64(128)
    TILE_N = T.int64(128)
    TILE_K = T.int64(32)

    # 64 × 64 tiles for the Attn‑V matmul, 32 × 32 threads per block
    TILE_M2 = T.int64(64)
    TILE_N2 = T.int64(64)
    TILE_K2 = T.int64(64)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Scaled‑dot‑product‑attention kernel
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    @T.prim_func
    def scaled_dot_product_attention(
        Q: T.handle, K: T.handle, V: T.handle, Out: T.handle
    ) -> None:
        T.func_attr({"global_symbol": "scaled_dot_product_attention", "tir.noalias": True})

        # ---------------------------- buffers ----------------------------
        q = T.match_buffer(Q, (B, H, S, D), dtype="float16")
        k = T.match_buffer(K, (B, H, S, D), dtype="float16")
        v = T.match_buffer(V, (B, H, S, D), dtype="float16")
        out = T.match_buffer(Out, (B, H, S, D), dtype="float16")

        # temporary buffers (fp32) – keep them in shared memory to avoid DRAM traffic
        scores = T.alloc_buffer((B, H, S, S), dtype="float32", scope="shared")
        attn   = T.alloc_buffer((B, H, S, S), dtype="float32", scope="shared")

        # ---------------------------- phase 1 ----------------------------
        # Q @ Kᵀ  → scores (scaled)
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        scale = T.float32(1.0) / T.sqrt(T.cast(D, "float32"))

        # Fuse batch & head dimensions for easier block mapping
        for bh in T.thread_binding(T.serial(B * H), thread="blockIdx.x"):
            for i_tile in T.serial(S // TILE_M):
                for j_tile in T.serial(S // TILE_N):
                    # shared tiles
                    s_q = T.alloc_buffer((TILE_M, TILE_K), dtype="float16", scope="shared")
                    s_k = T.alloc_buffer((TILE_N, TILE_K), dtype="float16", scope="shared")

                    # each thread computes one element of the output tile
                    for ti in T.thread_binding(T.serial(TILE_M), thread="threadIdx.y"):
                        for tj in T.thread_binding(T.serial(TILE_N), thread="threadIdx.x"):
                            acc = T.float32(0.0)

                                for kk in T.serial(TILE_K):
                                    s_k[tj, kk] = k[bh // H, bh % H,
                                                    j_tile * TILE_N + tj,
                                                    kk_tile * TILE_K + kk]
                                T.tir.evaluate(T.tir.call_pure_extern("tvm_storage_sync", "shared"))

                                # dot product
                                for kk in T.serial(TILE_K):
                                    acc += T.cast(s_q[ti, kk], "float32") * T.cast(s_k[tj, kk], "float32")
                            scores[bh // H, bh % H,
                                   i_tile * TILE_M + ti,
                                   j_tile * TILE_N + tj] = acc * scale

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------

                for j in T.serial(S):

                    attn[bh // H, bh % H, i, j] = exp_val
                    sum_exp += exp_val

                for j in T.serial(S):
                    attn[bh // H, bh % H, i, j] = attn[bh // H, bh % H, i, j] * inv_sum

        # ---------------------------- phase 3 ----------------------------
        # attn @ V → out
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        for bh in T.thread_binding(T.serial(B * H), thread="blockIdx.x"):
            for i_tile in T.serial(S // TILE_M2):
                for d_tile in T.serial(D // TILE_N2):
                    # shared tiles
                    s_attn = T.alloc_buffer((TILE_M2, TILE_K2), dtype="float32", scope="shared")
                    s_v    = T.alloc_buffer((TILE_K2, TILE_N2), dtype="float16", scope="shared")

                                for kk in T.serial(TILE_K2):

                                                          kk_tile * TILE_K2 + kk]
                                # load V tile (col)
                                for kk in T.serial(TILE_K2):

                            score_row[ti, tj] = score_row[ti, tj] * scale

                    # ----------------------------------------------------------
                    # Softmax (row‑wise) – compute max, exp, sum, normalize
                    # ----------------------------------------------------------
                    # max per row
                    for ti in T.serial(TILE_M):
                        max_val = T.float32(-3.4e38)
                        for tj in T.serial(TILE_N):
                            max_val = T.max(max_val, score_row[ti, tj])
                        # exp & sum
                        sum_exp = T.float32(0.0)
                        for tj in T.serial(TILE_N):
                            exp_val = T.exp(score_row[ti, tj] - max_val)
                            soft_row[ti, tj] = exp_val
                            sum_exp += exp_val
                        # normalize
                        for tj in T.serial(TILE_N):
                            soft_row[ti, tj] = soft_row[ti, tj] / sum_exp

                    # ----------------------------------------------------------
                    # Multiply softmax row with V to produce output
                    # ----------------------------------------------------------
                    for kk_tile in T.serial(S // TILE_N):
                        # Load V tile (cols)
                        for tj in T.thread_binding(T.serial(TILE_N), thread="threadIdx.x"):
                            for td in T.serial(TILE_D):
                                s_v[tj, td] = v[bh_batch, bh_head,
                                                kk_tile * TILE_N + tj,
                                                d_tile * TILE_D + td]
                        T.tir.evaluate(T.tir.call_pure_extern("tvm_storage_sync", "shared"))

                        # Accumulate
                        for ti in T.thread_binding(T.serial(TILE_M), thread="threadIdx.y"):
                            for td in T.thread_binding(T.serial(TILE_D), thread="threadIdx.x"):
                                for tj in T.serial(TILE_N):
                                    acc[ti, td] += soft_row[ti, tj] * T.cast(s_v[tj, td], "float32")

                    # ----------------------------------------------------------
                    # Write back the output tile
                    # ----------------------------------------------------------
                    for ti in T.serial(TILE_M):
                        for td in T.serial(TILE_D):
                            out[bh_batch, bh_head,
                                i_tile * TILE_M + ti,
                                d_tile * TILE_D + td] = T.cast(acc[ti, td], "float16")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # PyTorch‑compatible wrapper
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    class ModelNew(nn.Module):
        def __init__(self):
            super().__init__()
            target = "cuda -arch=sm_90"
            self.mod = tvm.build(
                fused_scaled_dot_product_attention,
                target=target,
                name="fused_scaled_dot_product_attention",
            )
            self.func = self.mod["fused_scaled_dot_product_attention"]
            self.device = tvm.cuda(0)

        def forward(self, Q: torch.Tensor, K: torch.Tensor, V: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
            Q = Q.to(torch.float16).contiguous().cuda()
            K = K.to(torch.float16).contiguous().cuda()
            V = V.to(torch.float16).contiguous().cuda()

            q_arr = nd.from_dlpack(torch.utils.dlpack.to_dlpack(Q))
            k_arr = nd.from_dlpack(torch.utils.dlpack.to_dlpack(K))
            v_arr = nd.from_dlpack(torch.utils.dlpack.to_dlpack(V))
            out_arr = nd.empty(q_arr.shape, dtype="float16", device=self.device)

            self.func(q_arr, k_arr, v_arr, out_arr)

            return torch.utils.dlpack.from_dlpack(out_arr.to_dlpack())

except ImportError:
